mapper.sql: SELECT p.post_id, p.board_id, b.board_name, p.title, p.content, p.author_id, u.user_name AS author_name, p.view_count, p.active, p.created_at FROM board_post p JOIN board b ON b.board_id = p.board_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = p.author_id
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_post p
AND p.active = #{active}
WHERE p.board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY p.post_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_post (board_id, title, content, author_id, view_count, active) VALUES (#{form.boardId}, #{form.title}, #{form.content}, #{authorId}, 0, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE board_post SET active = 0 WHERE post_id = #{postId}
UPDATE board_post SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE post_id = #{postId}
